notes: CONFIRMED from the paper: the 4-year follow-up of the Italian Network for Research on Psychoses cohort, 618 of the 921 recruited at baseline.
CONFIRMED: single-site cognitive remediation cohort at Kariya Hospital psychiatric day care, Aichi, Japan.

CONFIRMED and DISAMBIGUATED. The cohort is the routine Danish OPUS early-intervention service at Aarhus and Aalborg, OPUS start dates 1 Jan 2014 to 31 Dec 2019. It is a different sample from opus_1998, the 1998-2000 OPUS randomised trial; the windows do not overlap and OPUS admits only incident patients. Two arms, not two cohorts: both groups share one entry definition and differ only by site and intervention.
CONFIRMED: the prospective first-episode integrative-treatment cohort, 199 admitted March 2004 to February 2008.

The retrospectively formed treatment-as-usual comparison group (n = 114 after 2 exclusions). Separately assembled from patients of other departments, so it is a second cohort under D12.5 rather than a subgroup arm. It contributes NO result: its only employment outcome is a mean total duration of employment in months over the 10-year follow-up.
CONFIRMED: the whole IPS programme caseload at St Vincent's Hospital Melbourne, March 2006 to February 2013, N = 137 referred and engaged, 136 analysed.

CONFIRMED: the 1987 Finnish Birth Cohort, restricted to the 288 members diagnosed with a nonaffective psychotic disorder in 2004-2007. Overlaps Finnish nationwide register cohorts (fi_registers) which are not independent of it.
